evidence_schema.dict_ref_summary_finding: 本轮核查：ref 指向归档定位/来源提交+行，summary 为旧内容摘要，finding 为相对 pinned main 的核查发现
evidence_schema.dict_detail_line_path: 精确位置：path 指向 main 或归档文件，line 为行号，detail 为该行细节
evidence_schema.note: 三种 dict 形态语义不同，不是字段缺失；下游脚本须按形态分派，勿混用

method: Review all original base-to-archive changes for each decided path against pinned main; preserve intentional replacements and historical drafts. Evidence descriptions are review summaries, not verbatim quotations unless explicitly shown. Retention is distinct from correctness or executed acceptance. Patch hashes use git diff --no-ext-diff --unified=3 BASE ARCHIVE -- PATH.
